questions.intro: Competitors are businesses selling something similar to the same customers. Alternatives are any other way customers solve the problem today, including doing it themselves, using a free tool, or doing nothing. A lawn-care business competes with other lawn services, but also with homeowners who mow their own lawns. Studying competitors and alternatives shows what customers already accept, what they pay, and what they complain about. "No competition" usually means you have not looked hard enough, or that few people want it.
